# SARIF schema fixture

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is an unmodified copy of the official OASIS SARIF
2.1.0 schema incorporating Errata 01, retrieved on 2026-09-24:

https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json

It is stored locally so validation tests do not require network access.
The schema is machine-readable content from the OASIS SARIF standard:
https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/sarif-v2.1.0.html
